title: Sakamoto Days Ends With Shonen Jump’s Best 2026 Finale
content: Out of all five major Shonen Jump manga series that ended in 2026, Sakamoto Days had the best ending. 2026 has been a very important year for the manga and anime industry, witnessing several revolutionary changes and making a significant impact on the entertainment industry as a whole.
author: ComicBook

title: Dragon Ball Super Will Never Evolve Without Going Beyond Dragon Ball Z’s Ending
content: As long as Dragon Ball Super remains stuck within the ten year gap of time before the end of Dragon Ball Z , the story is never truly going to have the amount of freedom to explore its potential as fans might want.
author: ComicBook

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Studio’s Next Shonen Jump Anime Shares New Look Ahead of Jump Festa 2027
content: The studio behind hits such as Jujutsu Kaisen, Attack on Titan and more has a new Shonen Jump anime coming our way next year, and has dropped a new look at it ahead of its next big update during Jump Festa 2027 later this December.
author: ComicBook

title: Major Horror Anime Drops New Opening Ahead of Netflix Debut – Watch Now
content: A cool new horror thriller is set to make its anime debut with Netflix later this week, and has dropped its official opening theme sequence early to help celebrate its premiere.
author: ComicBook

title: Historie Anime Reveals New Visual, Trailer Additional Cast
content: The previously announced Historie anime revealed a new visual and trailer on Wednesday along with additional voice cast members. Studio LIDEN FILMS is animating the series, set to premiere in January 8, 2027.
author: Anime Corner

content: Black Clover is reaching the final stretch of its episodes for Season 2 this year, but the latest episode really took fans by surprise with a sudden confession of love. title: Link Click Season 3 Confirms 2027 Return for Part 2 With New Look
content: Link Click confirms a 2027 release window for Season 3 Part 2. Crunchyroll brought back the new season of this beloved series in August this year as part of the Summer 2026 anime lineup.

title: The Kept Man of the Princess Knight Anime Reveals New Trailer, Additional Cast, January 3 Premiere
content: The Kept Man of the Princess Knight anime revealed a new trailer, additional cast and a January 3, 2027 premiere date. title: Kindergarten WARS Unveils New Visual and Trailer, Opening Theme Song Artist Ado
content: Kindergarten WARS anime has unveiled the main visual and a new trailer on Wednesday. The latest trailer features the opening theme song “Bibayatarametta” by Ado. The series debuts in April 2027. Studio Sunrise and Felix Film are animating the series with Shinsuke Gomi as director.

title: Demon Slayer Studio’s New Movie Confirms Return With New Sequel
content: The newest movie from the studio behind the Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba anime franchise has announced it’s now working on a new sequel to its latest release, Witch on the Holy Night. Studio Ufotable has been busy the last few years with all sorts of new projects now in various stages of development.
